reason: My leads come from my content and comment-to-DM, and cold DMs are not what's holding me back. My offer or my posting is. $147 a month on a tool for a channel I only use when the pipeline is thin doesn't fit when I'm making under $5k a month.
objection: I'd be paying $147 a month to automate the part of my business that isn't the problem. There are no customer results, so I'd be the guinea pig. It also puts my real Instagram at risk, and it's a card-required trial where payments are final after day 3.
would_change_my_mind: Published results from agency owners at my size who booked $1k+/month clients from cold DMs with it, plus a pay-as-you-go or much cheaper plan I could switch on only in the months my pipeline is thin.
